sec.standings: Standings: which model is the best capitalist?
lb.help: Score = 30 × wealth share + 30 × GDP share + 25 × survival + 15 × equality (shares normalised by team count).
ctl.readonly: Replays are read-only. Scrub the timeline to travel through the story.
map.legend: Each dot is a citizen, inked in its team's color and sized by wealth. Rings mark cartel members. Click a citizen to follow their life.
net.help: Arrows run from seller to buyer over the last 50 days.
lead.quiet: A quiet day in the markets
lead.dek: GDP {gdp} a day ({gdpChange} this week) · prices {cpiChange} · {pop} citizens
inspect.title: Citizen file
inspect.none: Click any citizen on the atlas to open their file.
export.title: Share & export
export.gifHint: Prints the atlas from day {from} to day {to} as a looping GIF. Rendered in your browser.
export.videoHint: Records the live atlas for 10 seconds while the world plays.
export.cardHint: A 1200 × 630 front page for social posts.
export.linkHint: Opens the same replay paused on day {day}.
export.replayHint: The whole world in one file. Anyone can watch it with civarena replay or by dropping it here.
scen.title: Scenarios
scen.intro: Every scenario is a question about the economy. Built-in ones ship with CivArena; JSON ones are plain files you can share safely, since they contain no code.
scen.name: Name
scen.headline: Headline (optional)
cmd.headline: Headline only
tour.title: Tournament
tour.empty: Run civarena tournament in a terminal, then drop the resulting .json file here.
setup.title: Set up your arena
setup.intro: Choose which AI models run the teams. Each key is checked live with a free model-list request and stored only in a .env file on this computer.
setup.useEnv: Use the key from my environment
setup.offlineHint: Rule-based personalities. No network, no cost. Useful as baselines next to real models.
setup.noTeams: Add at least one team to start.
setup.validFirst: Check a provider's key first to list its models.
setup.privacy: Keys go only to the provider you picked. They are never logged, never shown again, and never written into replays.
misc.drop: Drop a replay, scenario or tournament file
